review_queue.raw_value: each holder of Company Shares converted pursuant to the Titanium Merger who would otherwise have been entitled to receive a fraction of a share of Parent Shares (after aggregating all shares represented by the Certificates and Book-Entry Company Shares delivered by such holder) shall receive, in lieu thereof, cash, without interest, in an amount equal to such fractional part of a share of Parent Shares multiplied by the closing price of Parent Shares on the NYSE on the last trading day immediately preceding the Titanium Merger Effective Time, rounded to the nearest cent (with 0.5 of a cent being rounded upward) (the “Merger Fractional Share Payout”)
